description: Working days calculator: counts the business days between two dates in any of 220+ countries, excluding weekends and public holidays, and lists the holidays excluded. Local weekends supported. Verified calendars for South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt, Ghana and 6 more African countries. Useful for SLAs, turnaround times, leave days and deadlines measured in business days. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. ZA (default), NG, KE, EG, IN, AE, SA, US, GB, DE, BR, CN (220+ countries). Verified calendars for ZA, NG, KE, EG, GH, MA, RW, UG, TZ, MU and BW

to.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive), within 5 years of 'from'
